name: We Are Not The Same
aka: Gus Fring We Are Not The Same
look: A promotional portrait of Giancarlo Esposito as Gus Fring, a man with close-cropped hair and glasses in a gray-blue suit, light blue shirt and dark tie. He stares coolly at the camera while adjusting his tie with both hands against a dark teal background.
use: A smug comparison. The first line says what you do, the second says what I do, usually the same thing done in a slightly superior or absurd way, and the last line declares we are not the same.
slots: what I do instead, often barely different (second line)
the closing line: we are not the same (bottom)
examples: You set an alarm to wake up on time
I set seven alarms to wake up late
I throw them away and build it twice
describe: breaking bad guy in a suit fixing his tie
gus fring adjusting his tie in glasses
man in glasses and a gray suit with you vs me text
meme comparing what you do and what i do
serious man in a blue suit straightening his necktie
origin: A promotional portrait of Giancarlo Esposito as Gus Fring, the character from Breaking Bad and its spin-off Better Call Saul.
